idea: Letters & first words #1 – Letter A (SUNNY PARK picnic): a big chunky red foam letter A pops out of Baby Jimmy's picnic basket ('Wow! Look! A big letter A!'); A says a-a-a (say it with me) and 'Draw an A with me: up, down, across!' (copy-me); A is for apple – Jimmy lifts a shiny red apple; A is for ant – a cute little cartoon ant dances on his palm; review 'A! Apple! Ant!' with claps; he asks the viewer 'What does A say? Hmm?' (pause) – 'A says a, a, a! Yay!'; lesson 'A is for apple and ant!'. Loop: the hook framing again, A, apple and ant in a neat row, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Letter A: its name, its short 'a' sound, and two A words – apple and ant.
place: SUNNY PARK (reference image park.jpg) – picnic on a plain yellow blanket
calendar: Thursday slot 1 – Letters & first words (A–Z series #1: A)
characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue t-shirt with a small yellow star, navy blue shorts and white sneakers with yellow laces.

supporting_objects.letter_a: THE LETTER A: a big chunky red foam capital letter A (two slanted sides, one crossbar), as tall as Jimmy's head.
supporting_objects.apple: THE APPLE: one big shiny round red apple with a small brown stem and one green leaf.
supporting_objects.ant: THE ANT: a cute round little cartoon ant, shiny reddish-brown, big friendly smiling face, big shiny dark eyes, two curly antennae and six tiny legs, toy-like and never scary.

setting: SUNNY PARK: a sunny park with a playground with a red slide and yellow swings, a small duck pond with white ducks and a little wooden bridge, a big green tree, a winding stone path, flower beds and a white bench.

learning.goal: Know the letter A, its short 'a' sound and two A words: apple and ant.
learning.shown_how: A real 3D red foam letter A pops out of the basket (0:00), then a red apple beside his face (0:09), then a cute ant on his palm (0:13); all three in a neat row at the end.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:19-0:21 'What does A say? Hmm?' over the loop shot (question boing) + 0:21-0:23 humming pause → 0:23 'A says a, a, a! Yay!' with a cheer
learning.copy_me: 0:03-0:07 'Say it with me: a, a, a!' and 0:07-0:10 'Draw an A with me: up, down, across!'
learning.fact_check: Capital A correct in every frame (two slanted sides + one crossbar, upright); A says short /a/ as in apple and ant (song prompt explicitly asks for the short sound, never 'ay'); exactly one apple and one ant; no other letters/numbers/text anywhere.
learning.modeling: Jimmy is gentle with the little ant (holds it softly on his open palm); no wrong choice to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, big face, friendly toy-like ant, bright calm park, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: letter A pops out of the picnic basket
copy-me: draw an A in the air
interactive pause: What does A say?

story_order.apple: shots 1-2 absent (in basket), appears shot 3, present 4-5

image_model: nano-banana-2.1 (nano-banana-2 failed with internal errors on every call today, incl. a plain text prompt)

shots.role: HOOK – letter A pops out of the basket, Jimmy gasps, claps, points
letter A – Jimmy reaches for the A, smiles (only 0.6-2.8 s usable: after 3 s C1 added a second bent A)
apple – Jimmy lifts one red apple beside his face
ant – a cute ant dances on his palm, he points and giggles
LOOP ENDING – edit of the hook frame: A, apple, ant in a row, bye-bye wave
